format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: Анна Котова изменила статус
Сергей Иванов изменил описание

probes.title: inline: the old value, a picture arrow, a hidden «на», the new value in medium weight; the arrow is glued to the new value's first word and the values wrap inside their box; no label without show-label
probes.covers: settings.before, settings.after, settings.label, settings.layout inline, accessibility

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#inline'); const arrow = el.querySelector('.sf-change__arrow'); const after = el.querySelector('.sf-change__after'); const before = el.querySelector('.sf-change__before'); return el.textContent.replace(/\s+/gu, ' ').trim() === 'Собран → на Передан в доставку' && arrow.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' && el.querySelector('.sr-only').textContent.trim() === 'на' && Number(getComputedStyle(after).fontWeight) > Number(getComputedStyle(before).fontWeight) && getComputedStyle(el.querySelector('.sf-change__pair')).whiteSpace !== 'nowrap' && /на\u00a0Передан/u.test(el.querySelector('.sf-change__pair').textContent) && getComputedStyle(before).textDecorationLine === 'none' && !el.querySelector('.sf-change__label') && !el.querySelector('sf-badge'); })()

(() => { const box = document.querySelector('#box').getBoundingClientRect(); const el = document.querySelector('#wrap'); const after = el.querySelector('.sf-change__after'); const arrow = el.querySelector('.sf-change__arrow'); const rects = [...after.getClientRects()]; return rects.length > 1 && Math.max(...rects.map((r) => r.right)) <= box.right + 0.5 && Math.abs(arrow.getClientRects()[0].top - rects[0].top) < 2; })()

probes.title: show-label prints «Ответственный: »; an empty value reads «пусто»
list: a dl from the changes attribute, the label the term and the pair its description; null reads «пусто»; under 24rem the label stands over its pair

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#list'); const dl = el.querySelector('dl.sf-change--list'); const terms = [...dl.querySelectorAll('dt')].map((dt) => dt.textContent); const stack = document.querySelector('#stack'); const t = stack.querySelector('dt').getBoundingClientRect(); const d = stack.querySelector('dd').getBoundingClientRect(); const wt = dl.querySelector('dt').getBoundingClientRect(); const wd = dl.querySelector('dd').getBoundingClientRect(); return terms.join('|') === 'Вес|Склад' && dl.querySelectorAll('dd')[1].querySelector('.sf-change__after').textContent === 'пусто' && el.hasAttribute('data-block') && d.top >= t.bottom - 0.5 && Math.abs(wt.top - wd.top) < 0.5 && wd.left > wt.right; })()

probes.title: a long value is folded behind «Показать изменения»; its press reveals «Было» and «Стало» in place and the button says «Скрыть изменения»

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#long'); const b = el.querySelector('.sf-change__toggle'); const blocks = el.querySelector('.sf-change__blocks'); return b.querySelector(':scope > span').textContent.trim() === 'Показать изменения' && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && b.getAttribute('aria-controls') === blocks.id && blocks.hidden && !el.querySelector('.sf-change__pair'); })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#long'); const b = el.querySelector('.sf-change__toggle'); const labels = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-change__block-label')].map((one) => one.textContent).join('|'); return b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && !el.querySelector('.sf-change__blocks').hidden && labels === 'Было|Стало' && b.querySelector(':scope > span').textContent.trim() === 'Скрыть изменения' && el.hasAttribute('data-revealed') && document.activeElement === b; })()

probes.title: nothing to say draws nothing and sets data-empty; a new after draws again
